subject: Initial pass at branchfree s32 implementation
perf_evidence: Commit introduces a branchfree signed-32 division path for speed.
change_summary: Introduces signed-32 branchfree generation/division and changes shared generator logic.

units.name: new signed-32 branchfree division result versus previous branchfull division result
units.evidence: Alive2 gives valid n=-1599033344, d=13: old branchfull returns -123002564 (the C truncated quotient), new branchfree returns -123002565. The separately compiled constant-input cex reproduces a one-off mismatch.

units.name: existing signed/unsigned 32/64-bit branchfull generated division
units.evidence: All four existing branchfull API targets pass both Alive2 directions.

notes: The signed branchfree API did not exist before this commit. The comparison uses the old branchfull API as a same-result quotient specification, not as a same-interface refinement. The valid-output witness is sufficient to show the introduced optimization changes the arithmetic result.
